summary: Stamp duty refund for lost e-stamp paper; interpretation of Section 49(a) of relevant Act; 'obliterate' includes loss; Article 14 and 265 considerations; technological safeguards against misuse; indemnity bond sufficient; taxing event not occurred; High Court partly allowed refund of principal amount; appeal challenges rejection of refund claim.
final_judgment: Leave granted; appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; refund of Rs. 28,10,000/- ordered.
